ItemID: NA; Title: Vol. 3: The Subliminal Verses; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Heavy riffs with melodic passages fit my current interest in Disturbed and In Flames.
ItemID: NA; Title: City of Evil       Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The melodic metal sound appeals, but I would prioritize a few closer matches this time.
ItemID: NA; Title: The End of Heartache; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: The mix of aggressive riffs and strong melodic vocals fits what I enjoy in my recent metal listening.
ItemID: NA; Title: Ascendancy       Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Its melodic, thrashy approach feels like a good next choice after In Flames and Advance And Vanquish.
ItemID: NA; Title: St. Anger       Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: The raw, repetitive approach is less appealing right now than melodic riffs and more developed arrangements.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Sickness; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Having recently listened to Ten Thousand Fists, I would like to explore more of Disturbed's heavy grooves.
ItemID: NA; Title: The War Within; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Its aggressive riffing and melodic leads connect well with my interest in heavier, guitar-driven albums.
ItemID: NA; Title: Mezmerize       Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The heavy riffs and unusual song structures appeal, but it would wait behind my strongest picks.
ItemID: NA; Title: Leviathan; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The heavier, more intricate material interests me after Tool, though I would save it for another session.
ItemID: NA; Title: Live In Texas; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am more interested in exploring studio albums right now than choosing a live recording.
